decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint fits the firm's pipeline core business, was promoted to its own page, and likely meets aspirations in a growing industry, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core but uses existing coating and fabrication equipment and sells to municipal customers, so slack from a growing industry lets the firm carry it despite uncertain results.

The waste bin with ashtray is a variant within the same street-furniture line, so its marginal cost is low and the firm can keep it while results remain uncertain, though as a niche variant it is somewhat more likely to be pruned.
The outdoor ashtrays are distant from the core, but they share production with the bin line and serve existing municipal customers, so no clear shortfall yet justifies dropping them.
